text: https://github.com/lstpsche/obsidian-mcp this is the one all llm should use via the 1mcp server. Help clean all other references or servers for obsidian.

cmd:
echo "=== project .mcp.json ==="; cat "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/.mcp.json" 2>&1
echo; echo "=== project .claude/settings.json ==="; cat "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/.claude/settings.json" 2>&1
echo; echo "=== project .claude/settings.local.json ==="; cat "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/.claude/settings.local.json" 2>&1
echo; echo "=== ~/.claude.json mcpServers (grep obsidian) ==="; grep -i -A5 -B5 "obsidian" ~/.claude.json 2>&1 | head -150
echo; echo "=== ~/.claude/settings.json ==="; cat ~/.claude/settings.json 2>&1

echo "=== chezmoi source: obsidian references ==="
grep -ril "obsidian" ~/.local/share/chezmoi 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.git/"
echo
echo "=== chezmoi 1mcp config ==="
find ~/.local/share/chezmoi -iname "*1mcp*" 2>/dev/null

echo "=== chezmoi 1mcp mcp.json ==="; cat ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_config/1mcp/mcp.json 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in d.get('mcpServers',d).items() if 'obsidian' in k.lower()}, indent=2))" 2>&1
echo
echo "=== deployed ~/.config/1mcp/mcp.json (if different) ==="
diff ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_config/1mcp/mcp.json ~/.config/1mcp/mcp.json 2>&1
echo
echo "=== Claude Extensions installed ==="
ls -la ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude/Claude\ Extensions/ 2>&1
echo
echo "=== manifest.json for the obsidian-mcp-connector extension ==="
cat ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude/Claude\ Extensions/local.mcpb.stefano-ferri.obsidian-mcp-connector/manifest.json 2>&1 | python3 -m json.tool 2>&1 | head -60

echo "=== ~/.claude.json mcpServers keys (top-level) ==="
python3 -c "
import json
with open('/Users/leon.ormes/.claude.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)
print('top-level mcpServers:', list(d.get('mcpServers', {}).keys()))
projects = d.get('projects', {})
for path, cfg in projects.items():
    servers = cfg.get('mcpServers', {})
    if servers:
        print(path, '->', list(servers.keys()))
" 2>&1
echo
echo "=== Claude Extensions Settings file ==="
cat ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude/Claude\ Extensions\ Settings/*.json 2>&1 | head -100
ls -la ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude/Claude\ Extensions\ Settings/ 2>&1

echo "=== claude_desktop_config.json (mcpServers) ==="
python3 -c "
import json
with open('/Users/leon.ormes/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)
print(json.dumps(d.get('mcpServers', {}), indent=2))
" 2>&1
echo
echo "=== search top-level Claude app support files only (not session/cache dirs) for stefano-ferri / obsidian-mcp-connector ==="
find ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude -maxdepth 1 -type f | xargs grep -l "stefano-ferri\|obsidian-mcp-connector" 2>/dev/null
echo
echo "=== cargo obsidian-mcp binary check ==="
ls -la /Users/leon.ormes/.cargo/bin/obsidian-mcp 2>&1
/Users/leon.ormes/.cargo/bin/obsidian-mcp --version 2>&1 || /Users/leon.ormes/.cargo/bin/obsidian-mcp --help 2>&1 | head -20

cp "/Users/leon.ormes/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json" "/Users/leon.ormes/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-preobsidiancleanup"
echo "backup created:"
ls -la "/Users/leon.ormes/Library/Application Support/Claude/" | grep "preobsidiancleanup"

EXT_DIR="/Users/leon.ormes/Library/Application Support/Claude/Claude Extensions/local.mcpb.stefano-ferri.obsidian-mcp-connector"
EXT_SETTINGS="/Users/leon.ormes/Library/Application Support/Claude/Claude Extensions Settings/local.mcpb.stefano-ferri.obsidian-mcp-connector.json"

# back up settings json (tiny, cheap insurance) before removing
cp "$EXT_SETTINGS" "/private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/c4f9b5f7-09f5-4ad1-b9df-5ebcc80157ea/scratchpad/obsidian-mcp-connector-settings.json.bak" 2>&1

rm -rf "$EXT_DIR"
rm -f "$EXT_SETTINGS"

echo "=== remaining extensions ==="
ls -la ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude/Claude\ Extensions/
echo
echo "=== remaining extension settings ==="
ls -la ~/Library/Application\ Support/Claude/Claude\ Extensions\ Settings/
